items.title: Intent Cursor with SET to ACTIVE to CONSUMED to CLEARED Lifecycle

items.title: Fix A4 via resumeTargetRef Capture-at-Pause + Unified Resume Seed
items.description: Introduce resumeTargetRef; pause() captures heardFloor BEFORE strategy clears scheduler sources; resume() reads from priority chain intent ?? resumeTarget ?? subscriber. Fixes A4 (play->pause->play resets to book start).
items.notes: Source merged at db2d1bc; anchor-correctness follow-up merged at 1299808. Live A4 retest still recommended before user-facing gate is declared closed.

items.title: Collapse 14 Reseed Paths + Delete Dormant-Engine Code (Kokoro-Only)
items.description: Collapse 14 speakNextChunk paths in applyRateChange (lines 1722-1871) into single restartGeneration(reason) helper; delete Web/Qwen/Pocket/Nano reseed branches per Kokoro-only design constraint; fold applyVoiceChange into same helper. Fixes A5 (rate-change skip).
items.notes: Also owns: A5 1.4x-bucket overlap buffer-flush (cancel prior-tempo queued sources on rate-INCREASE; only 1.4x jumbles, 1.2/1.3 clean) + unblocks SUBSCRIBER-CURSOR-1 reducer-removal (remove last cursorWordIndex audio readers).

items.title: Retire WORD_ADVANCE Reducer Action; Visual Highlight via Direct Callback
items.description: If NARRATE-CURSOR-TRACKING-DIAG-1 confirms the subscriber/direct-callback model, rename lastConfirmedAudioWordRef -> subscriberCursorRef, remove cursorWordIndex from React reducer state, remove WORD_ADVANCE action, and wire visual/view follow via the verdict-approved live target.
items.notes: GATED on NARRATE-HEARD-CURSOR-1 live-QA (2026-06-01 restructuring). Heavy WORD_ADVANCE/reducer removal dispatches ONLY if HEARD-CURSOR-1 verdict is PARTIAL (residual React-batching lead). PASS => unnecessary (dissolve/defer). Wave A enumeration folded into HEARD-CURSOR-1.

items.title: Rate-Change Reseed from Heard Position
items.description: Reseed applyRateChange Kokoro bucket-change from heardFloor, not nextGenWordIndexRef (A5 fix)
items.notes: Position fix merged 145c385; residual 1.4x-bucket overlap -> APPLYRATECHANGE-COLLAPSE-1. No formal CloseOut authored (interim evidence: live-QA gate report). Reconciled 2026-07-02.

items.title: Narrate Cursor Tracking Diagnostic
items.description: Instrument cursor, heard-floor, anchor, Foliate, and Flow follow signals to prove which source should drive visible cursor and view-follow before another fix.
items.notes: Live-QA trace 2026-05-31 (Meditations, DIAG on/reverted). Hypothesis REFUTED: schedulerActiveWord==heardFloor lead the heard voice; wordIndex (visible cursor) closest but still leads & drifts; nextGenWordIndex is pre-fetch frontier; resumeTarget/subscriberCursor no-data. SUBSCRIBER-CURSOR-1 amended -> publish lag-compensated heard cursor. See investigations/NARRATE-CURSOR-TRACKING-DIAG-1.md.

items.title: Drive Highlight + Reading-Window from One Tunable Lag-Compensated Heard Cursor
items.description: Route both the visible highlight and FlowScrollEngine.followWord through ONE lag-compensated heard cursor (getAudioProgress / heard-floor clamp); extract tunable TTS_VISUAL_CURSOR_LAG_MS; tune by ear. No reducer/WORD_ADVANCE change. Live-QA verdict gates SUBSCRIBER-CURSOR-1.
items.notes: 2026-06-01 ULTRATHINK probe-first restructuring (NARRATE-CURSOR-WINDOW-SYNC.md). The cheap reversible test of the cursor/window fix. PASS closes the desync line; PARTIAL dispatches SUBSCRIBER-CURSOR-1; FAIL re-opens investigation.
